sources.title: SaFo-Lab/Latent_Policy_Guard
sources.summary: Latent Policy Guard (LPG) — a guardrail model that performs semantic latent deliberation over dynamic safety policies. LPG compresses intent and risk reasoning into latent tokens and emits a compact policy-indexed verdict.

sources.title: oguzhantopgul/skill-security-reviewer
sources.summary: An AI skill that teaches language models how to perform intelligent security reviews of agent skills. Unlike static scanners that match patterns, this skill enables contextual threat analysis, intent reasoning, and detection of novel attacks.

sources.title: sharmaroshan/Online-Shoppers-Purchasing-Intention
sources.summary: In this data set we have perform classification or clustering and predict the intention of the Online Customers Purchasing Intention. The data set was formed so that each session would belong to a different user in a 1-year period to avoid any tendency to a specific campaign, special day, user profile, or period.
